company.name: Oneistox
company.shortDescription: Oneistox is the upskilling ecosystem for the design community for technical skills and critical thinking.
company.description:
Oneistox offers online cohort-based courses for designers, architects to advance their professional growth. Its team is focused on building tech-backed systems meant to learn design through two-way interaction and feedback unique to design learning. 

The company was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.
